title: Seething Boucheclier - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Seething Boucheclier in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A second mask connected to the Visages Axon, encountered in the Visages area. Killing it before Mask Keeper is one of the three pre-fight reductions that measurably lower the difficulty of the second stage.

sections.title: How to Beat the Seething Boucheclier
sections.content:
What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.
